summary: Every requirement (R1-R9), every dated ruling and all eighteen earnable acceptance criteria have implementing work I can point at: the folder rework and both images in ArgoCDTools (P1-P4), the catalog entry in HelmCharts (P5), the register in AnsibleSpecs (P6) and the rotation records plus the Architecture declaration in Ansible (P7). I re-derived the ones a done-record could have overstated rather than taking them: all eleven HelmCharts generator tests have named successors in aac-tools/tests (V15), the manifest declares argocd-hook and aac-tools as separate components with their own build and test verbs (V18), the catalog entry sits under controllerConfig with a memory limit and no command/args (V06), and V04's current wording now matches the line P6 landed at decisions.md:599. V19 is owed to the operator by construction — nothing in this pod runs an image — and the test phase records it; ArgoCDTools' README and CLAUDE.md's related-repos paragraph are the doc phase's, as both done-records say. Nothing else the reviewers found is undelivered work: it is a defect in delivered work, out of scope, or the operator's call, and all of it is already in the close-out at the right altitude, so no phase clears the bar.
